redCandidate.publicEntry: managed shell installation and codemap install/doctor
redCandidate.setup: Run the component-level public launcher and code-review-graph configuration tests in an isolated temporary home and project.
redCandidate.expected: Shell setup exposes a managed aios command from any working directory, and codemap configures code-review-graph for every registered client including Hermes without overwriting unrelated MCP entries.
redCandidate.observed: The command exited 1 with six contract failures: aios and aios.cmd launchers were absent; Hermes had no codemap target, install projection, or doctor repair entry.
redCandidate.failureReason: The shell shim catalog only contains client commands, and the codemap target catalog omits Hermes YAML even though Hermes is in the shared client registry.
